panels.title: Mean R per week, money stages

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('7 days', at) AS time, (payload->'trade'->>'strategy_id') || ' ' || (payload->'trade'->>'strategy_version') AS metric, avg((payload->'trade'->>'r_multiple')::float) AS value FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'PositionClosed' AND payload->'trade'->>'account_id' <> 'shadow' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('7 days', at) AS time, (payload->'trade'->>'strategy_id') || ' ' || (payload->'trade'->>'strategy_version') AS metric, avg((payload->'trade'->>'r_multiple')::float) AS value FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'PositionClosed' AND payload->'trade'->>'account_id' = 'shadow' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT at AS time, payload->>'strategy_id' AS strategy, payload->>'strategy_version' AS version, payload->>'from_stage' AS from_stage, payload->>'to_stage' AS to_stage, payload->>'reason' AS reason FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'StageChanged' AND payload->>'to_stage' IN ('shadow', 'micro', 'retired') AND payload->>'from_stage' IN ('micro', 'live', 'scaled', 'shadow') AND $__timeFilter(at) ORDER BY at DESC
